title: Minimum Operations to Make Sum Divisible
description: In one operation, decrease any positive array element by 1. Find the minimum number of operations needed so the sum of `nums` is divisible by positive integer `k`. Input: non-negative array `nums` and `k`. Output: the minimum operations.
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
